name: ContextMenu
summary: A menu of commands opened at a point on something (a right-click, Shift+F10 or the Menu key), as design tools do: its commands in groups, each with its key shown, some unavailable, and at most one level of submenu (Wrap in). Not for a button's own menu (MenuButton) or a value that stays chosen (Select). Opening it never moves anything; it acts only through `onSelect`.
a11y: The WAI-ARIA APG menu: `role="menu"` named by `label`, groups as `role="group"`, each command the one popup ListItem (`menuitem`, `aria-keyshortcuts` from its shortcut, `aria-disabled`, `aria-haspopup` on a submenu). It opens in the top layer at the point, inside the window; focus moves to its first available command and returns to where it was on Escape or a choice. Unavailable commands are skipped by the arrow keys but stay readable.

keys.action: next or previous available command, wrapping
next command whose name starts with it
chooses the command; on a submenu, opens it at its first command

keys.keys: Arrow right on a submenu command
keys.action: opens it; Arrow left or Escape in the submenu: closes it, back to its command
closes the menu and returns focus; Tab closes it and moves on

props.description: The commands in their groups, in a meaningful order; a hairline separates the groups.

props.name: value

props.name: label
props.description: The command, in sentence case: "Duplicate", "Wrap in".

props.description: The command's key, shown at the item's end and announced ("Ctrl+D"). Shown only: the consumer binds it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Can't be chosen here; it stays in its place so the menu doesn't change shape.
